title: Separate Artifact Standard Subset Implementations And Fixture-Test Every Mutation
description: Every single artifact standard subset implementation must be separate (own io/schema/mutations/oracle/fixtures/tests under 🏅️standards/🔖️<version>/🪆️subsets/<subset>/), never shared or collapsed at the artifact level. Every single artifact mutation must be tested over fixtures (real-world example, handcrafted, or generated by a third-party oracle library). Audit the whole repo for violations — notably tests living at artifact level (e.g. ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/📄️pdf/🧪️tests/mutate-pdf-1-4-a) instead of at subset level, subsets without their own implementation, and mutations without fixture-backed tests — then fix them all.
